title: Don't Starve Together is playable with friends on OpenPak
body: Don't Starve Together now works online on OpenPak, with Klei's own login, lobby browser and shard list served by us. Players on a real Switch and in our emulator have joined each other's worlds, and cross-device joining works. Each player needs their own OpenPak account, since two separate accounts are required to play together. Gather, build and survive together in the wilderness with your friends.
footer: OpenPak Don't Starve Together — playable, not promised.
